searchText: He is not 😦 I just noticed something: is the transaction root in ExecutionPayloadHeader an ssz hash or rlp hash? <vdWijden> It's rlp, but we're consider changing it to ssz (which is the discussion above) uh interesting On the CL side it's already an SSZ tree hash. Atm there are two types called `ExecutionPayloadHeader`. See: <https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/bellatrix/beacon-chain.md#process_execution_payload> but would that make the ExecutionPayloadHeader invalid for Execution? EL will reject such Header. is there any reason why? <vdWijden> They transform it before passing to the el, thats why we want to change it in el okay that is good to know was that an actual intentional design choice and is there actually a reason though? just curious <vdWijden> 🤷‍♀ its just weird to me that the "Execution"PayloadHeader is not an Execution object I think it was to avoid having RLP in the CL or SSZ in the EL. Now that we're post-merge it seems both CL and EL are more willing to incorporate both. okay, that means that I was indeed not hallucinating lol

excerpts.author: funnygiulio
excerpts.content: I just noticed something: is  the transaction root in ExecutionPayloadHeader an ssz hash or rlp hash?

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <vdWijden> It's rlp, but we're consider changing it to ssz (which is the discussion above)

excerpts.author: sproul
excerpts.content:
On the CL side it's already an SSZ tree hash. Atm there are two types called `ExecutionPayloadHeader`.

See: <https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/bellatrix/beacon-chain.md#process_execution_payload>

excerpts.author: funnygiulio
excerpts.content: but would that make the ExecutionPayloadHeader invalid for Execution?  EL will reject such Header. is there any reason why?

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <vdWijden> They transform it before passing to the el, thats why we want to change it in el

excerpts.author: funnygiulio
excerpts.content: okay that is good to know

excerpts.author: funnygiulio
excerpts.content: was that an actual intentional design choice and  is there actually a reason though? just curious

excerpts.author: funnygiulio
excerpts.content: its just weird to me that the "Execution"PayloadHeader is not an Execution object

excerpts.author: sproul
excerpts.content: I think it was to avoid having RLP in the CL or SSZ in the EL. Now that we're post-merge it seems both CL and EL are more willing to incorporate both.
